Look up smd_note_duration_table[key] for tick count

Set chan+0x68/0x7E and bit 0x200; fold velocity into pitch packing
Test bit 0x8000 of chan[0]; if set, stage KON via bit 0x300 + bit 0x1FF
Branch target for byte>=0x80; converts opcode to (opcode-0x80)*4 jumptable index
Convergence after note OR control path; loop or exit on bits 0x500
Save stream pointer to chan+0x16 then exit inner loop
